sources: BLS CPI data — US Urban CPI (USD)
UK Office for National Statistics — CPI (GBP)
Official company announcements and investor relations press releases
metadata.notes: All prices are monthly in local currency unless stated otherwise. Annual plan prices are shown as monthly equivalents (annual total / 12). 'N/A' indicates a tier did not exist at that date. Services not officially available in a country are omitted from that country's dataset. Prices reflect the standard public price — introductory offers excluded.

USD.source: BLS US Urban CPI (CPI-U), annual average

GBP.source: UK ONS CPI, annual average index (2015=100)

EUR.source: Eurostat HICP — Euro area annual average (1996=1.0)

AUD.source: Australian Bureau of Statistics CPI, annual average (1989-90=100)

CHF.source: Swiss Federal Statistical Office CPI, annual average (2015=100)

JPY.source: Statistics Bureau of Japan CPI, annual average (2020=100)

NZD.source: Statistics New Zealand CPI, annual average (2006=1000)
